programme.how_found: WebSearch (site:cuni.cz) 'Charles University Faculty of Mathematics and Physics Bachelor Computer Science English admission requirements' -> https://www.mff.cuni.cz/en/admissions -> sidebar link 'Programmes' -> https://www.mff.cuni.cz/en/admissions/programmes. The sidebar link 'Bachelor of Computer Science' (https://www.mff.cuni.cz/en/students/bachelor-of-computer-science) is the curriculum page; its heading is 'Bachelor of Computer Science'. The 2026/27 requirements page calls it 'the Bachelor of Computer Science programme given in English'.
programme.notes: Three specialisations inside the one programme: General Computer Science, Databases and Web, Artificial Intelligence (chosen by end of year 2). The Czech-taught bachelor 'Informatika' (SIS: 'Computer Science', Bachelor's, Czech, 3 years, id_obor=36459) is a separate programme and is not the subject of this record. In SIS the English-taught bachelor is not yet listed in the faculty's programme table for the 2027/28 cycle as of 2026-10-17 (only the Czech-taught one), although the faculty's SIS admission text for the English bachelor with 2027 dates is already published.

english.quote: - TOEIC Listening and Reading: 945 - The International English Language Testing System (IELTS): 7 - Cambridge C1 Advanced: Pass - Cambridge C2 Proficiency: Pass
english.how_found: WebSearch result 'Admission> General and faculty requirements' (is.cuni.cz) for the same query as the programme page -> SIS 'General and faculty requirements' page for Faculty of Mathematics and Physics (fak=11320), section 'Bachelor's study programmes' -> 'English Language Proficiency' -> 'Minimum Test Score' list.
english.notes: These are the minimums in the SIS faculty admission text that carries 2027 dates (documents due 'preferably by June 30, 2027, and by September 30, 2027, at the latest'; test validity 'as of April 30, 2027'), i.e. the 2027/28 cycle, although the SIS page does not label the bachelor section with an academic year. TOEFL iBT is published there as '- TOEFL iBT: 5.5 points. To submit your score electronically, please use Institution code 3184.' — 5.5 is not a valid TOEFL iBT total (scale 0-120), so it is omitted from the value as an apparent error on the official page; the previous cycle's faculty page (https://www.mff.cuni.cz/en/admissions/admission-requirements-for-bachelor-s-programmes-in-english, headed 'Admission Requirements for Bachelor's Programmes in English (2026/2027)') listed 'TOEFL iBT 85', 'The International English Language Testing System (IELTS) 6.5', 'Duolingo 110', PTE 66 — so the thresholds were raised for 2027/28. Tests must not be older than two years. Exemption only for applicants with at least two years of English-medium schooling in Australia, Canada, Ireland, Malta, New Zealand, South Africa, UK or USA (Kazakhstan NIS is not exempt); 'comparable qualifications demonstrating proficiency in English (i.e. CEFR level C1) also meet our requirements'.

value.description: No GPA / school-grade minimum is published. There is no entrance exam; admission is decided by reviewing the application against three conditions: a secondary school leaving certificate (recognised/nostrified), the minimum 'Reasoning Requirements' (one qualifying test score from the list) and English proficiency. Qualifying Reasoning scores: SAT total 1250 with Math >= 720; ACT composite 26 with Math >= 32; AP Calculus AB 5 or AP Calculus BC 4-5; IB 6 or higher in Mathematics AA HL or AI HL (IB total not a factor); GCE A/AS levels AAB incl. A in Mathematics; comparable results in other recognised qualifications (scores on request); exceptional results in contests such as the IMO; or meeting the admission requirements of the Czech-taught Computer Science programme. Test results must be no older than three years as of April 30, 2027.
value.value_meaning: SAT total score (with Math >= 720) — one of several alternative minimum Reasoning Requirements

alternatives.gce_a_levels: A A B including an A in Mathematics

gpa.quote: ### Minimum qualifications - AP Calculus AB: score 5 - AP Calculus BC: score 4 or 5 - SAT: total score 1250, including a score in Math of at least 720.
gpa.how_found: Same SIS 'General and faculty requirements' page (fak=11320) -> 'Bachelor's study programmes' -> 'Reasoning Requirements' -> 'Minimum qualifications'. Confirmed by faculty FAQ https://www.mff.cuni.cz/en/admissions/admission-faq ('Do I have to pass an entrance exam?' — 'No, but each application is reviewed and assessed with the goal of choosing applicants who have shown the capability expected of Charles University students.').
gpa.notes: Full SIS sentence: '- SAT: total score 1250, including a score in Math of at least 720. To submit your score electronically, please use Institution code 7249.' For a Kazakhstan NIS grade-12 diploma holder the practical route is SAT/ACT/AP or 'comparable results for other recognized qualifications ... (specific required scores may be provided on request)'. SAT Math is disregarded for applicants from countries where the faculty measured a low SAT-Math/credits correlation (in the 2026/27 round this was only Azerbaijan). The identical thresholds appear on the 2026/27 faculty page ('SAT Total Score 1250, including a score in Math of at least 720').

deadline.how_found: WebSearch (site:cuni.cz) 'mff.cuni.cz Bachelor Computer Science tuition fee English programme application deadline' -> https://www.mff.cuni.cz/en/admissions/costs-and-dates -> 'Important Dates for Applicants in Bachelor's and Master's Programmes'.
deadline.notes: This is the 2026/27-cycle date; the explicit application deadline for the autumn 2027 (2027/28) intake of the English-taught bachelor is NOT yet published as of 2026-10-17 (the faculty page is still headed 2026/2027 and the URL pattern .../admission-requirements-for-bachelor-s-programmes-in-english/2027-2028 returns 404). Strong official indicators that it will again be 30 April: the SIS 2027-cycle bachelor text says 'Test results demonstrating satisfaction of Reasoning Requirements must not be older than three years as of April 30, 2027.' and requires documents 'preferably by June 30, 2027, and by September 30, 2027, at the latest.'; the SIS master's section for the same cycle states 'Application deadline: April 30, 2027'; the faculty FAQ says 'The deadline is usually April 30th.' (the 'th' is a superscript on the page) Application server opens in December (2025 for the 2026 cycle). Non-EU applicants are advised to apply well before the deadline because of visa processing. Application fee 1500 CZK, payable by the 3rd day after the deadline.

tuition.quote: The tuition fee for students from the EU is 4200 EUR per academic year, for students from outside the EU 7100 EUR per academic year from 2026/27.
tuition.how_found: Same 'Costs and Dates' page -> 'Tuition Fees for Bachelor's and Master's Programmes'.
tuition.notes: 2027/28 fee not yet published; 'from 2026/27' is the latest named year. The CSTF 2026 scholarship page states the same figures ('4 200 EUR per academic year for students from the EU, and 7 100 EUR per academic year for students outside the EU'). A Kazakhstan citizen is a non-EU student -> 7100 EUR/year. FAQ: fee best paid before Registration Day (late September), due by end of October. Living costs 600-750 EUR/month per the same page.

scholarship_exists.quote: The Scholarship is open to candidates applying for the Bachelor’s or Master’s Programmes in Computer Science, at the Faculty of Mathematics and Physics, Charles University, language of instruction English, for the academic years beginning 2026/2027
scholarship_exists.how_found: https://www.mff.cuni.cz/en/admissions -> 'Scholarships' (https://www.mff.cuni.cz/en/admissions/scholarships: 'Starting from Academic Year 2026/27, the Faculty of Mathematics and Physics, Charles University, offers the following scholarships to highly qualified applicants:' -> 'Computer Science Tuition Fee Scholarships for the Bachelor's Programme in Computer Science') -> https://www.mff.cuni.cz/en/admissions/scholarships/cstf-scholarships-2026
scholarship_exists.notes: Faculty-run, awarded by the Dean on academic excellence; tuition waiver of 4 200 EUR up to 21 600 EUR (full tuition for 3 bachelor years); '3) Up to six Scholarships will be awarded for students in the Bachelor's Programme in Computer Science'. Apply with the programme application plus CV, motivation letter, transcripts, an email CSTFS application and two recommendation letters; '7) Candidates must not be recipients of any other scholarship or maintenance grant.' The published call is for 'the academic years beginning 2026/2027' with '8) The deadline for submitting applications is 30 April 2026.'; the 2027 call is not yet published (…/cstf-scholarships-2027 returns 404 on 2026-10-17). The CU-wide Scholarship and Bursary Rules were not reviewed.

scholarship_international.quote: which amounts to 4 200 EUR per academic year for students from the EU, and 7 100 EUR per academic year for students outside the EU.
scholarship_international.notes: The eligibility clause (regulation 2) restricts only by programme, language of instruction and prior study, not by nationality; regulation 4 expressly covers 'students outside the EU' at the non-EU fee rate, and the intro says the waiver depends on 'the applicant's chosen programme, academic performance and country of origin.' No sentence uses the words 'international students'.

access_notes: All official pages were reachable without login. First pass used the WebFetch summariser; every quote was then copied from raw HTML downloaded with curl and verified programmatically as a whitespace-normalised substring of the page.

is.cuni.cz 'General and faculty requirements' page (fak=11320) is server-rendered but displays its markup characters literally ('## ', '### ', '- ' bullets); quotes reproduce them as displayed. The page does not state the academic year for the bachelor section; it is identified as the 2027/28 cycle by its 2027 dates. The SIS programme search (do=obory) needs a form/JavaScript submission; a GET returned only the form, so the English-taught bachelor's SIS detail page for 2027/28 could not be opened (it is not in the faculty's SIS programme table yet).
No 2027/2028 edition of the faculty's bachelor requirements page exists yet (…/2027-2028 -> HTTP 404); the live page is labelled 2026/2027. No CSTF 2027 page exists yet (HTTP 404).
The TOEFL iBT minimum on the SIS 2027-cycle text reads '5.5 points', which cannot be a TOEFL iBT total; treated as an apparent error and reported in notes only.
